alloy.preparation: As-received mill-annealed plate machined to specimens; wet ground on silicon-carbide papers down to 600 grade. Plain blocks 11 × 11 × 7 mm with drilled/tapped connection, PTFE compression gasket and insulated rod of the same alloy; some initial tests used 25 × 13 × 7 mm blocks with a bolted radially grooved 16 mm PTFE washer assembly, plain backing washer and 6 N m torque.

test_solution.preparation: Neutral chloride solution, deaerated with nitrogen for cyclic polarization; continuous aeration belongs to the separate immersion tests.

test_method.procedure_description: Parr 1 L titanium autoclave; external Ag/AgCl reference maintained at 25 °C and system pressure. IR compensation; scanned from Ecorr at 20 mV/min, reversed at approximately 1 mA/cm² and terminated below repassivation. Plain and creviced specimens were tried initially; subsequent tests did not require the artificial crevice assembly. Specimens examined with stereomicroscope up to ×160; some by SEM. Authors report potentials on SHE(T), assuming negligible thermal-junction potentials.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Passivation breakdown Eb on the upward sweep of the cyclic curve; localized attack could involve PTFE-mount crevice corrosion and/or pits on freely exposed surfaces. Low-temperature curves can contain transpassive zones and ambiguous hysteresis.

experiments.result_note: Passivation-breakdown Eb from cyclic polarization; the authors explicitly cannot cleanly distinguish pitting from crevice attack and discuss ambiguous low-temperature curves/transpassive zones. It is retained as a qualified localized-corrosion potential, not certified as a pure pitting threshold. Approximate graphical reading. This illustrative 1% NaCl curve is not one of the Alloy 625 concentration series in Figure 4. Table 1 reports combined Cb + Ta = 3.54 wt%; separate Nb and Ta amounts cannot be assigned. Material UNS N06625.

test_solution.preparation: Neutral chloride solution, deaerated with nitrogen for cyclic polarization; continuous aeration belongs to the separate immersion tests.

test_method.procedure_description: Parr 1 L titanium autoclave; external Ag/AgCl reference maintained at 25 °C and system pressure. IR compensation; scanned from Ecorr at 20 mV/min, reversed at approximately 1 mA/cm² and terminated below repassivation. Plain and creviced specimens were tried initially; subsequent tests did not require the artificial crevice assembly. Specimens examined with stereomicroscope up to ×160; some by SEM. Authors report potentials on SHE(T), assuming negligible thermal-junction potentials.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Passivation breakdown Eb on the upward sweep of the cyclic curve; localized attack could involve PTFE-mount crevice corrosion and/or pits on freely exposed surfaces. Low-temperature curves can contain transpassive zones and ambiguous hysteresis.

experiments.result_note: Passivation-breakdown Eb from cyclic polarization; the authors explicitly cannot cleanly distinguish pitting from crevice attack and discuss ambiguous low-temperature curves/transpassive zones. It is retained as a qualified localized-corrosion potential, not certified as a pure pitting threshold. Approximate graphical reading. Material UNS N10276.
